title: Apple-Banana Plăcintă with Spelt & Lard Pastry

slides.alt: A tray of apple pie cut into rectangular bars with golden spelt pastry on a pale blue plate, on a woven mat, with the text "This is what happiness looks like."

A few pieces of apple pie with golden crust and soft apple filling on a pale blue plate, with a white shape in the lower right holding the text "This pie's crumble, mmmm, mmmm, ok I'm eating, don't talk to me."
